remarks: Fall in love from the moment you arrive at this beautifully maintained Pepper Ridge charmer, perfectly situated on a picturesque corner lot with exceptional curb appeal. Step inside and discover a warm, welcoming home designed for both comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The heart of the home has open-concept kitchen and dining room, creating the perfect gathering space for family meals and friendly get-togethers. The inviting living room features a cozy fireplace, while a sun-filled office provides an ideal work-from-home retreat. A convenient half bath completes the main level. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, including a spacious primary with custom closets, even a walk-up attic offering excellent storage or future expansion possibilities. The newly finished lower level adds valuable living space, additional half bath, laundry area, and walk-out access to the backyard. Recent improvements include a new natural gas heating system, split A/C system, updated lighting, dishwasher, garage door, smart home features, and an irrigation system that keeps the fenced in yard lush and green. Additional highlights include gleaming hardwood floors throughout, attached garage, city water and sewer, and a highly desirable location close to schools, the library, and swim club. This move-in-ready home combines timeless charm, thoughtful updates, unbeatable neighborhood setting - don't miss the opportunity to make it yours
